site.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer fayilu tilali min jɔra bi tɛkɛnɛlɔɲi cɛncɛnbaliw kan. Cɛncɛn sɛrɛwɛri tɛ yen. Yɔrɔ kelen ka bin tɛ yen.

hero.subtitle: Wakatti kura peer-to-peer fayilu tilali
hero.description: A jɔra bi tɛkɛnɛlɔɲi cɛncɛnbaliw kan. Cɛncɛn sɛrɛwɛri tɛ yen. Yɔrɔ kelen ka bin tɛ yen.

about.title: A kan
about.intro: {project} ye wakatti kura peer-to-peer fayilu tilali yɔrɔ ye min jɔra bi tɛkɛnɛlɔɲi cɛncɛnbaliw kan. A be baarakɛla nɔgɔnyali ɲɔgɔnyali fara cɛncɛnbaliya labɛn dafalen kan, ka kunnafoni tilali fura lakanalen ni kankari fɔ min tɛ tilen cɛncɛn fanga si la. Poroze ye open source ye ani a bɛ tila {license} kɔrɔ.

decentralized.title: Cɛncɛnbaliya rezo dafalen
decentralized.description: Cɛncɛn sɛrɛwɛri tɛ yen, yɔrɔ kelen ka bin tɛ yen. Baarakɛlaw bɛ kunnafoniw ɲini ka jigin u cɛ la, k'a sɔrɔ u tɛ jigi cɛncɛn ɲinimakɛla, tɔginikɛla wala kunnafonimaraso kan.

accessControl.title: Donni kɔlɔsi ɲɛnafɔ-ɲɛnafɔ
accessControl.description: Bɛɛ ka kan ka u yɛrɛ ka rezo daminɛ ni u yɛrɛ ka sariyaw ye. Baarakɛlaw ka jɔrɔw fɔ rezo bɛɛ kɔnɔ: ti, admin, fɔlikɛla, ɲɛmɔgɔla ni jiginnikɛla. A kɔlɔsi ka ɲɛ jɔn bɛ se ka fɔli kɛ, ka ɲɛmɔgɔ kɛ ani ka kunnafoniw jigin.

ui.title: Baarakɛla labɛn ka kɔrɔn
ui.description: Media center labɛn jɛlen ani nɔgɔnen baarakɛla bolo, min labɛnna desktop, TV ani telefɔni misɛnniw kama. A taa ni gerɛjɔn nɔgɔya, mansa, gamepad wala fɔlɔdɔn kɔlɔsili ye. Baarakɛla cogo dɔnbagaw bɛ se ka fɛrɛli laseli labɛn kɛ ka sɔfutiwɛri kɛ fayilu sɛrɛwɛri ye min kun tɛ.

dataFormat.title: Kunnafoni cogoya min mɔgɔ bɛ se ka kalan
dataFormat.description: LISH kunnafoni cogoya jɔlen JSON kan, o b'a kɛ a ka nɔgɔn ka dabɔ, ka kalan ani k'a faamuya. I ka kunnafoniw tila ni metadata jɛlen, dafalen ye min mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ se k'a lajɛ nɔgɔya la.

security.title: Gundo ni lakanali
security.description: Peer-to-peer kuma bɛɛ bɛ kɛ kɛnɛ na ni encryption ye, ka i ka kunnafoniw to gundo na ka taa a fɛ. Baarakɛlaw bɛ se k'u dogo VPN kɔfɛ ka ɲɔgɔnyali wɛrɛ sɔrɔ. {project} bɛ i ka gundo bonya a labɛn la.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Sɔfutiwɛri bɛ Windows, Linux ani macOS yɔrɔw kama. A baara kɛ minan o minan i b'a fɛ.

download.title: Aw ka jigin
download.description: {project} sɔrɔ i ka yɔrɔ kama. Jiginni bɛɛ ye fu ye ani open source.
